title: docs(skills): the platform skill names every type a pair's override is served for, and that removing the pair's item serves the base's again
body:
Fixes #30229

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 的 ADR-0146 段落。定制包(`hotcrm.custom`)覆盖项的生效类型从原文的 6 种改为平台今天实际服务的 12 种(view、dashboard、report、email_template、translation、flow、page、app、dataset、doc、book、mapping),并补一句:删除定制包里的覆盖项(`DELETE …?package=hotcrm.custom`)即重新服务基础包原件。该技能的 evals 新增两例:dataset/page 覆盖、撤销覆盖。
- **为什么改**:客户的 AI agent 读这份 skill 来写 `.custom` 包。旧文案少列 6 种类型且只字不提撤销,它要么拒绝一个本可做的 page/dataset 定制,要么告诉客户定制无法撤销。
- **风险与回滚**:纯文案与 eval 夹具,不碰任何运行时代码。token 棘轮 6000 → 6009(上限 6011):新增以删掉同段两处重复表述付账,不是改折行。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 第 128 行(三处改动都在这一行:类型清单、撤销一句、两处删减);其次 `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` 新增 id 13、14。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期一行 `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md is 6009 tokens (ceiling 6011; headroom 2)` 且 exit 0;`git grep -n "today only for a view" skills/` 预期零命中。
- **需要你做的**:`skills/**` 为 Tier H,需人工批准后合并;审阅通过即合并本 PR。

## What changes

One paragraph of `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` ("Customizing an installed package (ADR-0146)", line 128), read against `origin/main` `fdd06415`:

- **The served-type list.** "today only for a view, dashboard, report, email_template, translation or flow" becomes "for a view, dashboard, report, email_template, translation, flow, page, app, dataset, doc, book or mapping". That is what the reads serve today: the five overlay types by their overlay path; `flow` by `declinesStoredRow`'s first branch (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-lock-state.ts`, ADR-0146 D9 item 1); `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `doc`, `book` and `mapping` by `SEALED_ROW_SERVED_OVERRIDE_TYPES` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts`, `mapping` the sixth since PR #30226).
- **The revert.** "…the layered read and both lists serve it, and removing the pair's item (`DELETE …?package=hotcrm.custom`) serves the base's again" — `isPairRowRemoval` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` admits a removal naming the pair for every open override type, and the base's document is served once the row is gone (pinned by `protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`, "once the pair's row is deleted, the read serves the base row again").
- **Paid for inside the same paragraph** (content deleted, not re-wrapped; each rule keeps another home): "and ignores any other package's declaration" (the next paragraph: "Only the pair declares: the save, publish and install doors, `os validate` and `os build` refuse `overrides` from any other package"), and ", never by a base-named or package-less read" (the same sentence already says "served only under its own `?package=`").
- **Evals** (`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`): id 13, a dataset-and-page override declared from `hotcrm.custom`; id 14, undoing an override by removing the pair's item. Both cases' `must_contain` tokens are taught by `SKILL.md` (checked by hand: `hotcrm.custom`, `overrides:`, `dataset`, `page`, `DELETE`, `?package=hotcrm.custom`). Case 13's `must_not_contain` is the two `PUT` routes alone (patch round).
- Changeset `.changeset/30229-adr0146-override-types.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, carrying both machine lines.

**Why the list and not the rule.** The card prefers a rule that does not age. The code's rule is "every open override type" — `isOpenOverrideType`: disposition `overridable` in `OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION` AND its ADR-0146 D9 conditions delivered (`CONDITIONS_DELIVERED` = `flow` alone). The spec's exported list `OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` (13 names) includes `action`, whose override the write door still refuses as `declared_type_not_yet_available`; naming that symbol would promise one type the platform refuses, and "overridable" has no shorter customer-facing phrasing than the twelve names (the excluded types — permission set, position, capability, object — are already named in the next paragraph). So the paragraph names the current list; when `action`'s door is cut it gains one word.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs` — exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs` — exit 0; `pnpm check:doc-authoring` — exit 0; `pnpm check:skill-top-level-keys` — exit 0.
- `@objectstack/skills` is the one package this diff ships through (its `build` is `sync-catalog.mjs`, a byte copy of `skills/**`): built under the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`), then `node packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs --check` — `97 file(s) under dist/skills are byte-identical to skills/**`, exit 0; `packages/skills/dist/skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` carries the new sentence and no longer carries "today only for a view"; the dist eval file carries id 14. The package declares no `test` or `typecheck` script, so ② is empty for it.
- The evals JSON parses (14 cases, ids 1–14).
- No ablation: no tested runtime behaviour changed (docs and an eval fixture).

## Acceptance notes

- NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`: `pnpm check:dts-closure`, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`, `pnpm check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` — each exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: they read every package's built `dist/`, a full workspace build this doc-only diff cannot move). A declared narrowing, not a skipped family.
- `pnpm check:dev-prereqs` (local-only family, owed because the lock run built `packages/spec`): exit 1, "the workspace is not built — 103 of 107 packages declare an entry under dist/ that is not on disk" — the fresh worktree's state, not a finding about this diff; `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness`: exit 0.
- Observation, not filed (zero pull): the `must_contain` token oracle `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` scans `ui/skills` only (`SCAN_ROOTS = ['skills']`, read under `ui/`), so the root `skills/*/evals/*.json` have no mechanical "is this token taught" check; the two new cases were checked by hand against `SKILL.md`.
- Observation, not filed (boundary, not a trap): `OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` in `@objectstack/spec` names `action` while the write door refuses an `action` override as not yet available (ADR-0146 D9, by design, with a message that says so). The skill text follows the door, not the spec list.

## Verification

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the actual diff (45 families; `--tier`: the MANDATORY tier, clause ①, `skills/**`, no one-line exit). Head `e3c97f55` (patch round: contract review 6657115315's should-fix — eval 13's `must_not_contain` no longer carries `only for views`, a substring of its own prompt; nothing else changed). The 45-family run below was taken at `75b0062c`; re-run at `e3c97f55` for the changed path: evals JSON parses (14 cases), `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exit 0 (SKILL.md 6009 / 6011; eval fixture 3251 tokens), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs` exit 0, `pnpm check:doc-authoring` exit 0.
